title: Flux-Based PM Controller
text: Controller for a flux-based permanent magnet synchronous motor, 7 inputs, 3 outputs, {Parameterize losses by} sets Select type Single efficiency; {Control Type} selects control Torque, {Number of pole pairs, PolePairs} sets the poles, {Vector of d-axis current breakpoints, id_index} sets the current vector, {Vector of q-axis current breakpoints, iq_index} sets the current vector, {Corresponding d-axis flux, lambda_d} sets the flux vector, {Corresponding q-axis flux, lambda_q} sets the flux vector, {Sample time for the torque control, Tst} sets the time 1e-4, {D-axis proportional gain, Kp_d} sets the gain, {Q-axis proportional gain, Kp_q} sets the gain, {D-axis integral gain, Ki_d} sets the gain, {Q-axis integral gain, Ki_q} sets the gain, {Vector of speed breakpoints, wbp} sets the breakpoints vector, {Vector of torque breakpoints, tbp} sets the breakpoints vector, {Corresponding d-axis current reference, id_ref} sets the current vector, {Corresponding q-axis current reference, iq_ref} sets the current vector, {Speed regulation time constant, Ksf} sets the time .1, {Proportional gain, Kp_w} sets the gain, {Integral gain, Ki_w} sets the gain, {Inertia compensation, Jcomp}, {Static friction, Fs} sets the friction, {Viscous damping compensation, Fv} sets the dampint, {Overall inverter efficiency, eff} sets the constant, {Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated loss, w_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of torques (T) for tabulated loss, T_loss_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Corresponding losses, losses_table} sets the table, {Vector of speeds (w) for tabulated efficiency, w_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints, {Vector of torques (T) for tabulated efficiency, T_eff_bp} sets the breakpoints and {Corresponding efficiency, efficiency_table} sets the table. Values come from the instance.
